name: Bottom Banner
description: The photo fills the top two-thirds; a solid tone banner along the bottom carries a headline (plain words, then an italic tail) and a short line.
photoTip: Keep the subject in the top half; the bottom third is cropped by the banner.

tones.note: All six tones work; the banner is the tone colour.

fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: One line. Put the italic part between asterisks: New work *is live.*

fields.label: Caption
fields.hint: Optional supporting line, up to two lines.
